intro: 'Lost in the Shadows' is a quest involving the rescue of Pal'juh, an impetuous hunter who ventured into danger alone. Her rescue highlights the delicate balance between raw aggression and patient stalking required of wilderness trackers.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, Pal'juh got herself in trouble again, did she?
Hopefully she learns her lesson about going alone this time. Thank you for helping her. She's a promising hunter, just tends to act more like a raptor than a tiger.
